app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The user pod was created with the wrong container image: the running pod spec for user-66d5d6f874-dsrsr uses gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest while the container command is set to "user". The pause image does not contain the application binary, so the container fails to start with: exec: "user": executable file not found in $PATH. The Deployment/ReplicaSet pod template shows the correct image (yinfangchen/hotelreservation:latest), so the immediate failure mechanism is the pod running the pause image instead of the application image.

args.root_cause: The user pod was created with the wrong container image: the running pod spec for user-66d5d6f874-dsrsr uses gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest while the container command is set to "user". The pause image does not contain the application binary, so the container fails to start with: exec: "user": executable file not found in $PATH. The Deployment/ReplicaSet pod template shows the correct image (yinfangchen/hotelreservation:latest), so the immediate failure mechanism is the pod running the pause image instead of the application image.
args.evidence_summary:
1) kubectl get pods (namespace test-hotel-reservation) showed user-66d5d6f874-dsrsr in RunContainerError with 6 restarts.
2) kubectl describe pod user-66d5d6f874-dsrsr showed the container Last State terminated with message: "exec: \"user\": executable file not found in $PATH" and events showing pull of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest and BackOff.
3) kubectl get pod -o json shows spec.containers[0].image: "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" and command ["user"] (mismatch).
4) kubectl get replicaset user-66d5d6f874 -o json and kubectl get deployment user -o json show the ReplicaSet/Deployment template image is yinfangchen/hotelreservation:latest (the intended application image).
args.investigation_summary: I listed pods to find failing components, described the failing pod to see the error, retrieved the pod JSON to inspect the live pod spec, and compared it to the ReplicaSet and Deployment templates. The running pod was using the pause image while its command expects the application binary, causing the startup failure. Deployment/ReplicaSet templates indicate the expected image is yinfangchen/hotelreservation:latest, so the error is localized to the pod that was created with the wrong image.
